items.title: Reactivity of the pi bond (printed as a second 11.7.1) (pi bond kyun jaldi react karta hai) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Reactivity of the pi bond, printed as a second 11.7.1 on pages 257-258.

blocks.text: Double bond ki wajah se alkenes alkanes se zyada reactive hain. π bond mein electron milne ki probability (imkan) dono nuclei ko milane wali line (lakeer) se door, us ke oopar aur neeche, hoti hai. Is wajah se π-electrons nuclei ke darmiyan kam mazbooti se pakre hote hain. Is liye π bond σ bond ke muqable mein kamzor bond hai. Reaction ke dauran yeh aasani se toot jata hai, aur is se alkenes reactive compounds bante hain. Is ke ilawa dheele pakre π-electrons electrophilic reagents (electron ke bhooke reagents) ke attack (hamle) ke liye zyada khule hote hain. Is liye alkenes electrophilic addition reactions bohat aasani se karte hain.

blocks.title: Did You Know?
blocks.text: Electrophile woh species hai jo electron pair le (accept kar) sakti hai; is ko E⁺ se dikhate hain. Alkenes nucleophile ka kaam karte hain kyunke un mein π electrons hote hain. Nucleophile woh species hai jo electrons ka pair de (donate kar) sakti hai; is ko Nu:⁻ se dikhate hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke Quick Check 11.5 mein part (c) ‘answer to (d)’ aur part (e) ‘answer to (f)’ kehta hai. Sahi yeh hai: (c) part (b) ka jawab samjhata hai aur (e) part (d) ka.

blocks.prompt: H₂, H⁺ aur OH⁻ mein se kaun nucleophile aur kaun electrophile ka kaam karega, aur kyun (Quick Check 11.5b se e)?
blocks.explanation: OH⁻ nucleophile hai: us par negative charge aur lone pairs hain jo woh de sakta hai. H⁺ electrophile hai: us ke paas koi electron nahi aur woh electron pair le leta hai. H₂ dono mein se kuch nahi: yeh bhare hue σ bond wala non-polar molecule hai jis ke paas dene ya lene ke liye na charge hai na lone pair.

blocks.text: Alkenes ki reactions zyada tar carbocations banne ke zariye hoti hain. Is liye alkenes ki addition reactions parhne se pehle carbocations aur un ki stability ko samajhna bohat zaroori hai.

items: π electrons nuclei ki line se door, dheele pakre aur khule hain: π bond aasani se toot-ta hai aur electrophiles ko kheenchta hai, is liye alkenes electrophilic addition karte hain.
Electrophile E⁺ = electron pair lene wala; nucleophile Nu:⁻ = electron pair dene wala; alkene ke π electrons use nucleophile banate hain.
